stable-2026.06.18 (caaf5af860)

Vendored from ~/Ambiq/sws/ambiqsuite/third_party/{cordio,uecc} at AmbiqSuite
commit caaf5af86087881647f56c70646c748d40c86e23 (snapshot stable-2026.06.18)
- cordio/{ble-host,ble-profiles,wsf}
- uecc (micro-ECC, used by ble-host/sources/sec)

This is the AmbiqSuite drop the non-atomiq110 provider headers and archives
come from, so the stack matches the HAL/BSP and device drivers it links
against on the BLE-capable parts. It was not re-vendored when the provider
identity moved to stable-2026.09.01 (3062036c4f) in 5.2.25; nsx-ambiq-sdk
5.2.25 recorded this label as stable-2026.09.01 (3062036c4f) in error, and
5.2.26 corrects it (see the nsx-cordio-vendored-revision-label known deviation
in release/nsx-ambiq-sdk-5.2.26.yaml).

uecc is an unmodified copy. cordio is unmodified except for these NSX edits
(introduced in nsx-ambiq-sdk PR #30 unless noted):
- ble-host/include/dm_api.h, ble-host/sources/stack/dm/dm_sec_lesc.c:
  DmSecSetEccKey(NULL) invalidates the local LESC key and DmSecGetEccKey()
  returns NULL when no valid key is available.
- ble-host/sources/sec/uecc/sec_ecc.c: report uECC key-generation and
  shared-secret failures instead of returning success with invalid keys.
- ble-host/sources/stack/smp/smp_sc_act.c: cancel LESC pairing with
  SMP_ERR_UNSPECIFIED when no valid local ECC key is available.
- ble-profiles/sources/services/svc_core.{c,h}: SvcCoreGapSetDevName() and a
  31-byte GAP device-name buffer.
- ble-profiles/sources/services/svc_dis.c: Ambiq/NSX Device Information
  Service defaults; DIS_DEFAULT_FW_REV tracks the distribution version and is
  bumped at every release.
